notes: kb/Work PB5242 landed. §1985:XIII.3.10.8 GR1: "The first line number on which a body group can be presented is the line number specified by the FIRST DETAIL phrase". GroupLimits' body upper limit is FIRST DETAIL unless a CONTROL HEADING carries OR PAGE, and OR PAGE is a 2002 phrase refused at 85 (report-control-operand-forms-2002, VisitReportGroupType), so at 85 the limit is always FIRST DETAIL; ScreenReportGroupLines refuses a body line above it (COBOL2199) and FirstLineTarget places a relative first body group there. Witness: 1985-GR-XIII_3_10_8-1. Each 2002 form is refused at --std 85 with COBOL0900 by a construct row of the version matrix (tests/version-matrix/constructs/report-*-2002.json, introducedIn 2002), checked on recognition in VersionConformancePass's parse arm, and accepted from COBOL-2002 (ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 115).

next.reason: 1985: 'The first line number on which a body group can be presented is the line number specified by the FIRST DETAIL phrase'. 2023 keeps it only conditionally: §2023:13.18.57.4 GR7 c) 'The upper limit for a body group, if there is no control heading defined in the report with the OR PAGE phrase, is the line given by the FIRST DETAIL integer', and adds d) 'If there is at least one control heading defined in the report with the OR PAGE phrase, the upper limit for a body group is determined as follows' (a lower control heading's limit follows the higher one). OR PAGE is accepted by 2023, refused by 1985: a case added.
